summary: Orchid Island Capital filed an 8-K reporting preliminary Q3 2026 results and declaring its monthly dividend. The mortgage REIT disclosed estimated book value of $6.02 per share as of September 30, 2026, and an estimated GAAP net loss of $0.90 per share, including $1.17 per share of net realized and unrealized losses on RMBS and derivatives. The board declared a $0.10 per share October dividend, payable November 27, 2026 to holders of record October 30, 2026, with the same ex-dividend date. This is a routine earnings and dividend update, not a special situation; monitor book value erosion and dividend coverage.
